title: Travel and incoming insurance plans | EC Assets
description: The private insurance plans for newcomers to Germany offered by our travel insurance partner: four levels of cover, direct billing, flexibility and free cancellation if your visa is refused.

blocks.html: Our travel insurance partner offers a private incoming insurance for people arriving in Germany.

It is recognised by embassies, priced fairly and comes with practical advantages: direct billing with doctors, flexible duration and cover even if you take a side job. If your visa is refused, the policy can be cancelled free of charge.
Cover is available in four levels, from basic health insurance to a bundle that adds accident, liability and dental cover.

items.html: Standard bundles international health insurance with accident insurance, personal liability insurance and cover for deportation costs.
Extended adds dental treatment to everything in Standard.

Complete is designed for students who cannot join statutory insurance, for example because they are 30 or older or have exceeded the maximum number of semesters. It includes benefits modelled on the statutory system up to €500 per insurance year.

They meet the legal requirements.
Insurance for foreign guests must satisfy EU regulations and German residence law. The plans provide unlimited cover for medical costs, well above the €30,000 minimum.

No deductible
A deductible is the part of a bill you pay yourself. These plans have none.

Direct billing
Show your insurance card at the practice or hospital and the insurer settles the bill directly.

Flexible duration
Stays rarely go exactly to plan. Cover can be extended up to four years, and if you leave early the premium is calculated to the day.

Side jobs are fine
A job alongside your studies does not affect the cover. Check with your employer whether social insurance contributions apply.

One contact for everything
Advice, contract, payment and claims are handled by the same team at the insurer.

blocks.text: Who can take out the plans

items.html: Age and maximum duration limits apply; the insurer shows them before you buy
You hold a nationality other than German
The policy is taken out before arrival or within the first month after entering the country or starting your course, studies, internship or research

blocks.html: In all EU countries plus Liechtenstein, Switzerland, Norway, Iceland, Andorra, Monaco, San Marino and Vatican City, which makes it suitable for a Schengen visa. Trips elsewhere in the world are covered for up to six weeks, so a holiday visit home is included.
